description: This file defines the ContentService interface, which provides method signatures for managing content related to merchant stores. It includes methods for listing, retrieving, saving, updating, adding, and removing content and content files, specifically for a CMS system within an e-commerce platform.

classes.name: ContentService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for managing content entities such as listing, retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting content and content files for merchant stores.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content objects filtered by a specific ContentType, store, and language.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content objects filtered by multiple ContentType objects, store, and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a Content object based on a unique code and merchant store.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a Content entity.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a Content object based on code, merchant store, and language.

methods.name: addContentFile
methods.description: Stores a content file (e.g., image, document) for a merchant store.

methods.name: addContentFiles
methods.description: Stores multiple content files for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific content file identified by name and type from a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Removes all content files associated with a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFile
methods.description: Retrieves a specific content file for a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFiles
methods.description: List all content files of a particular type for a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFilesNames
methods.description: Gets the list of filenames for content files of a specific type for a merchant store.

methods.name: addLogo
methods.description: Adds a logo to the merchant store.

methods.name: addOptionImage
methods.description: Adds an option image (such as a property image) for a merchant store.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists Content objects filtered by ContentType and store.

methods.name: listNameByType
methods.description: Lists ContentDescription objects filtered by ContentType, store, and language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a Content object by ID and language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves ContentDescription by store and SEO URL.
